svg.aria-label: Remove from a list, on disk. Remove the element at a random index, then push one, so the list keeps its length: one op is both. Each library's own persistence on node:fs, every write awaited. ops/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: Yjs (memory only — on disk the Yjs row stores every update already); Loro (memory only — on disk the Loro row appends every update already); TinyBase (no list that merges by position); PouchDB (no list that merges by position); RxDB (Node.js disk storages are Premium); Fireproof (no list that merges by position); GUN (no list that merges by position); OrbitDB (no list that merges by position).
